scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there. I'm checking on the status of a housing loan application I submitted recently. Do you have any information for me on that? My loan amount was $450,000 and the term is 240 months.
dialogue.agent: Your loan application, ID LOAN-01963, was denied.

dialogue.user: Oh no, denied? That's very disappointing. Can you tell me why it was denied?
dialogue.agent: The principal reason for the denial was the debt-to-income ratio.

dialogue.user: My debt-to-income ratio was too high? Can you tell me what that ratio was and what it means for my application?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio was 42%. This ratio compares your total monthly debt payments to your total monthly income.

dialogue.user: I see. So, a 42% DTI was the reason for the denial. Are there any other details about the application outcome that I should know? For example, what was the interest rate I was offered, or what are the total costs associated with this loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate and total loan costs are not applicable as the application was denied.

dialogue.user: Okay, I understand that the rate and costs are not applicable since it was denied. Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: This loan was not sold to another institution. The purchaser type is not applicable.

dialogue.user:
Well, this is certainly not the news I was hoping for. It's a shame the application was denied due to my debt-to-income ratio. I appreciate you clarifying that.

<Dissatisfied> I am dissatisfied because the application was denied, and I was hoping for a different outcome. Additionally, I would have liked to know more about potential rates or costs, even if it was denied, to understand better.
